text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-1932 — metering ingest: token anomaly detected (ingest consumer reported +12% unexpected token delta). Severity: high. @tim_oncall paging now. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/ingest/offsets/2934126789

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement required. Pager triggered to primary oncall: @tim_oncall -> notify: 1m repeat.

tim_oncall: acked. digging in. I'm on a call in 3m, will update ASAP. Can someone flag whether invoices are at risk? @sam_billing @nicole_support

maya_ops: looking. Early signs: consumer group ingest offset jumps in windowed partition 7-9. Replication lag rose ~40s. Reprocessing backlog spiked. Could cause undercounting for today if not addressed before next checkpoint.

sam_billing: If this persists through the hourly checkpoint we could miscount ~200k tokens for a small set of enterprise customers — not a sitewide invoice block yet, but could become an invoice risk. Starting customer impact assessment now.

lina_eng_l2: forwarding logs to a quick diagnostic job. Running `./scripts/ingest/offset-check.sh --partitions 7-9 --span 10m` now. Suspect a consumer fanout stall on the downstream writer.

maya_ops: notice a pattern: consumer pod aws-usage-consumer-3 is entering OOM kill/restart loop; JVM GC pressure observed in the pod logs. attaching snippet:

```
2026-03-14T03:12:04Z WARN GC overhead limit exceeded
2026-03-14T03:12:05Z ERROR consumer poll exception: fetch failed, offset not committed
2026-03-14T03:12:06Z INFO Restarting container: kubelet
```

nicole_support: flagging CS for customers with sensitive billing days (Acct: AcmeCorp, FinixLabs). I'll draft an initial customer note if we think invoices will be impacted in the next 2 hours.

tim_oncall: plan: 1) promote standby consumer -> scale up consumer count temporarily 2) isolate and restart node hosting aws-usage-consumer-3 3) pause automated checkpointing for affected partitions to avoid writing partial counts. Approving change now. @lina_eng_l2 can you handle the scale + restart?

lina_eng_l2: scaling consumers x2 for partitions 7-9 via k8s: `kubectl scale deployment/aws-usage-consumer --replicas=6 -n metering`. Will cordon node if restarts continue. Also pushing a consumer config bump: `max.poll.interval.ms=600000` for this deployment as a short-term mitigation.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: not acknowledged by responder team within 10m? resolved by ack from @tim_oncall. Logging incident timeline.

sam_billing: Based on current backlog and projected catch-up rate, estimate token shortfall window to be ~30-45 minutes if scale succeeds. Customer invoice risk: low->medium. Recommend creating a manual invoice hold flag for high-risk accounts and delaying finalization until reconciliation completes.

maya_ops: executed checkpoint pause for partitions 7-9: `POST /internal/ingest/checkpoints/pause {partitions:[7,8,9]}`. Checkpointing paused at 03:18Z. Will resume after manual verification.

nicole_support: Created incident ticket INC-1932-CUSTCOMM and added AcmeCorp & FinixLabs to watchlist. Draft update to customers ready for review: "We're investigating elevated metering delays that may affect today's usage reporting for select accounts; we will not finalize invoices until counts are verified"

lina_eng_l2: node cordoned and restarted container. Consumer pod came back healthy on second boot. Reprocessing worker launched for backlog; consumer throughput rising from 600rps -> 1.8k rps.

maya_ops: verifying token delta now. Running our delta projection job: `python infra/tools/token_delta_projection.py --lookback 20m --partitions 7-9`

```
Projection summary: backlog=1.2M tokens, projected catch-up in 22 minutes at current throughput.
Estimated exposed token shortfall if checkpoint remained: ~210k tokens across 14 customers (top impacted: AcmeCorp 112k, FinixLabs 35k)
```

sam_billing: Good recovery numbers. Recommend: 1) hold invoices for impacted customers until reconciliation completes 2) run targeted reprocess and reconciliation pass 3) run a differential audit job before unpausing checkpoints. I'll open a finance hold flag and notify legal if needed.

maya_ops: executed checkpoint pause for partitions 7-9: `POST /internal/ingest/checkpoints/pause {partitions:[7,8,9]}`. Checkpointing paused at 03:18Z. Will resume after manual verification.

nicole_support: Created incident ticket INC-1932-CUSTCOMM and added AcmeCorp & FinixLabs to watchlist. Draft update to customers ready for review: "We're investigating elevated metering delays that may affect today's usage reporting for select accounts; we will not finalize invoices until counts are verified"

lina_eng_l2: reprocess complete for partitions 7-9 at 03:42Z. Delta audit job running. Will post reconciliation report in 5m.

maya_ops: reconciliation report: `reports/reconcile/2934126789-summary.txt` summary below:

- reconciled tokens applied: 1.22M
- adjustments written: 14 customer accounts updated
- net delta per AcmeCorp: +113,274 tokens
- net delta per FinixLabs: +34,890 tokens

sam_billing: Verified adjustments and flagged invoices to remain on hold. Finance will not issue final invoices until midnight reconciliation sweep. No manual refunds required; adjustments will apply to next billing cycle per policy.

tim_oncall: closing notes: immediate cause: consumer pod GC pressure -> restart loop -> transient backlog. Mitigations: scaled consumers, bumped poll interval, cordoned node, paused checkpoints during reprocess, ran verification. Followups: 1) permanent autoscaling rule for consumer group (PR #487) 2) add alert to detect repeated GC restarts 3) postmortem to include checklist for invoice holds and CS comms.

nicole_support: creating a short customer-facing postmortem draft for affected accounts.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1932 moved to monitoring. Triggered after-action survey to involved participants.

tim_oncall: handoff to day oncall @lina_eng_l2 for monitoring. I'll mark resolved from my side but keep on-call for 30m in case of regression. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
